acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

returns.part: Total part of the debt held by borrowers.

params.newInterestRateBps: new interest rate in basis points

params.share: The amount of shares to add for `to`.
params.skim: True if the amount should be skimmed from the deposit balance of msg.sender.x False if tokens from msg.sender in `bentoBox` should be transferred.

firewall().details: 获取防火墙路由器地址

init(bytes).details: `data` is abi encoded in the format: (IERC20 collateral, IERC20 asset, IOracle oracle, bytes oracleData)

params.maxBorrowParts: A one-to-one mapping to `users`, contains maximum (partial) borrow amounts (to liquidate) of the respective user.
params.to: Address of the receiver in open liquidations if `swapper` is zero.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

params.actions: An array with a sequence of actions to execute (see OPERATION_ declarations).
params.datas: A one-to-one mapped array to `operations`. Contains abi encoded data of function arguments.
params.values: A one-to-one mapped array to `actions`. ETH amounts to send along with the actions. Only applicable to `OPERATION`, `OPERATION_BENTO_DEPOSIT`.

returns.value1: May contain the first positioned return value of the last executed action (if applicable).
returns.value2: May contain the second positioned return value of the last executed action which returns 2 values (if applicable).

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.skim: True if the amount should be skimmed from the deposit balance of msg.sender. False if tokens from msg.sender in `bentoBox` should be transferred.
params.to: Address of the user this payment should go.

params._blacklisted: true when the callee cannot be used in call cook action

setFirewall(address).details: 公开设置防火墙地址（仅在未设置时可调用，支持动态更新）

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

accumulate().notice: Accrues the interest on the borrowed tokens and handles the accumulation of fees.

borrow(address,uint256).notice: Sender borrows `amount` and transfers it to `to`.

changeBorrowLimit(uint128,uint128).notice: allows to change the borrow limit

changeInterestRate(uint16).notice: allows to change the interest rate

constructor.notice: The constructor is only used for the initial master contract. Subsequent clones are initialised via `init`.

depositCollateral(address,bool,uint256).notice: Adds `collateral` from msg.sender to the account `to`.

exchangeRate().notice: Exchange and interest rate tracking. This is 'cached' here because calls to Oracles can be very expensive.

init(bytes).notice: Serves as the constructor for clones, as clones can't have a regular constructor

liquidate(address[],uint256[],address,ad.notice: Handles the liquidation of users' balances, once the users' amount of collateral is too low.

performOperations(uint8[],uint256[],byte.notice: Executes a set of actions and allows composability (contract calls) to other contracts.

removeCollateral(address,uint256).notice: Removes `share` amount of collateral and transfers it to `to`.

setFeeTo(address).notice: Sets the beneficiary of interest accrued. MasterContract Only Admin function.

updatePrice().notice: Gets the exchange rate. I.e how much collateral to buy 1e18 asset. This function is supposed to be invoked if needed because Oracle queries can be expensive.
